branch_protection_configuration.description: Branch protection enforcement was enabled or disabled. Common repository filters identify the affected repository.

sender.description: Actor login; GitHub may use the ghost placeholder for events without a resolvable actor.

organization.description: Organization login, when included in the delivery.

repository.description: Repository owner/name, when included in the delivery.

code_scanning_alert.description: A code scanning alert changed, appeared in a branch, or changed assignment.

sender.description: Actor login, including the ghost placeholder when no actor can be resolved.

ref.description: Full Git ref associated with the alert.

custom_property.description: An organization or enterprise custom property definition changed.

custom_property_values.description: A repository's custom property values changed. Values may be scalar or array-valued; only property names are exposed as typed filters.

property_name.description: Property name in the new values.

previous_property_name.description: Property name in the previous values.

deploy_key.description: A repository deploy key was created or deleted.

read_only.description: Whether the deploy key is read-only.

deployment_protection_rule.description: A deployment requested evaluation by a custom deployment protection rule.

event.description: Event that triggered the deployment workflow.

deployment_review.description: A deployment review was requested, approved, or rejected.

job_environment.description: Environment associated with the reviewed job.

github_app_authorization.description: A user's authorization of a GitHub App was revoked; the common sender identifies the user.

sender.description: Login of the user whose GitHub App authorization was revoked.

installation.description: A GitHub App installation was created, deleted, suspended, restored, or granted new permissions.

repository_name.description: Full name of a repository included in the installation payload.

installation_repositories.description: Repositories were added to or removed from a GitHub App installation.

added_repository.description: Full name of an added repository.

removed_repository.description: Full name of a removed repository.

installation_target.description: The account targeted by a GitHub App installation was renamed.

issue_dependencies.description: An issue blocking relationship changed. Cross-repository deliveries can omit the other issue and its repository.

blocked_issue.labels.description: Label name on the embedded blocked issue.

blocking_issue.labels.description: Label name on the embedded blocking issue.

issue_relates_to.description: An issue relates-to relationship changed. Cross-repository deliveries omit the related issue and its ID; filters for absent related fields do not match.

related_issue_id.description: Related issue database ID; same-repository relationships only.

issue.labels.description: Label name on the embedded issue.

related_issue.labels.description: Label name on the related issue, when embedded.

on_free_trial.description: Whether the purchase is in a free trial.

member.description: A repository collaborator was added, removed, or had permissions changed.

membership.description: A user was added to or removed from a team.

org_block.description: An organization blocked or unblocked a user.

blocked_user_id.description: Blocked or unblocked user's database ID.

organization.description: Organization membership, invitations, name, or existence changed.

package.description: A package was published or updated. This is the package webhook, distinct from the native registry_package trigger.

personal_access_token_request.description: A fine-grained personal access token organization access request changed.

organization.description: Organization receiving the token access request.

token_name.description: Requested token name; never the token credential.

token_expired.description: Whether the requested token has expired.

ping.description: A webhook delivery test was sent. This payload has no action property.

project.description: A Projects (classic) project changed. Legacy event retained because current webhook documentation lists it; current native Actions documentation does not. Use projects_v2 for modern Projects.

project_card.description: A Projects (classic) card changed. Legacy webhook still documented but not a current native Actions trigger; use projects_v2_item for modern Projects.

project_url.description: API URL identifying the classic project.

content_url.description: API URL of the issue or pull request represented by the card.

project_column.description: A Projects (classic) column changed. Legacy webhook still documented but not a current native Actions trigger.

project_url.description: API URL identifying the classic project.

projects_v2.description: An organization-level Project changed. Project payloads do not embed issue labels; label filters are unavailable without a separate lookup.

is_template.description: Whether the project is a template.

projects_v2_item.description: An organization-level Project item changed. The payload contains content IDs, not an embedded issue or its labels; label filters are unavailable without a separate lookup. Field transitions can be null or typed values; select names and text/integer transitions have separate filters.

content_id.description: Issue, pull request, or draft issue GraphQL node ID.

field.name.description: Changed project field name, such as Status or Priority.

project_number.description: Project number supplied with a field change.

field.to.name.description: New single-select option name, including Status or Priority.

field.value.description: Alias for the new single-select option name; not a raw field value.

field.to.text.description: New string value for a text or date field; object and numeric values do not match.

field.from.text.description: Previous string value for a text or date field.

field.to.number.description: New integer value for a number field, as documented in the webhook schema.

field.from.number.description: Previous integer value for a number field.

projects_v2_status_update.description: An organization-level Project status update changed. No embedded issue labels are supplied.

repository.description: Repository settings, visibility, ownership, name, or existence changed.

repository_advisory.description: A repository security advisory was published or privately reported.

repository_import.description: A repository import changed status. This payload has no action property.

repository_ruleset.description: A repository ruleset was created, deleted, or edited.

repository_vulnerability_alert.description: A legacy repository vulnerability alert changed; prefer dependabot_alert for modern Dependabot alerts.

secret_scanning_alert_location.description: A new location was detected for a secret scanning alert. Filters exclude secret material.

location_type.description: Type of newly detected secret location.

secret_scanning_scan.description: A secret scanning backfill scan completed.

secret_type.description: A secret detector included in the scan.

security_advisory.description: A GitHub-reviewed global security advisory changed.

security_and_analysis.description: Repository security and analysis settings changed. This payload has no action property.

secret_scanning_push_protection.description: Current secret scanning push protection status.

is_one_time.description: Whether this is a one-time sponsorship.

star.description: A repository star was added or removed; unlike the native watch trigger, this includes unstars.

sender.description: Login of the user who starred or unstarred the repository.

starred_at.description: Star creation timestamp; absent or null when deleted.

sub_issues.description: An issue parent/sub-issue relationship changed. Embedded objects are parent_issue and sub_issue, not issue; cross-repository deliveries may omit the other issue.

parent_issue.labels.description: Label name on the embedded parent issue.

sub_issue.labels.description: Label name on the embedded sub-issue.

team.description: A team changed or gained or lost access to a repository.

team_add.description: A team was added to a repository. This payload has no action property; team.added_to_repository is a related but distinct webhook.

workflow_job.description: A GitHub Actions workflow job changed state; this webhook is distinct from the native workflow_run trigger.

sender.description: Actor login, including the ghost placeholder when no actor can be resolved.

runner_labels.description: Runner scheduling label, not an issue label.
